name: The Few Chosen CTF 2026
category_ids_note: The API returns category_id as a UUID and doesn't expose a lookup endpoint. This map was read off the handout shapes. netcat plus a zip carrying a libc is pwn, http or nodeport with a source zip is web, a bare stripped ELF is rev, a maths-flavoured zip with no service is crypto, and the pyjail plus Discord plus APK bucket is misc.
scoring: 80 percent jeopardy, 20 percent King of the Hill

result.points_note: Scoring is dynamic. Every challenge revalued downward as solve counts increased.
result.teams_note: 1022 total and 617 AI/open, read off the final leaderboard. Screenshots/captures from earlier in the contest may show different numbers.

readme_preamble:
2026-09-05 to 2026-09-06. Jeopardy is 80% of the score, a King of the Hill
arena is the other 20%.

Scoring is dynamic, so Points below is the value at close. Screenshot captions
taken during the contest often show a higher number. Our banked total read 3298
live and 2873 once the board settled.

[MEDIA.md](MEDIA.md) indexes the walkthrough screenshots, including which ones
show a placeholder flag instead of a real one.
